hooks.command: if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog gate --agent claude --event PermissionRequest; elif [ "${DUOLOG_DEPTH:-0}" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then exit 2; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog hook PostToolUse --agent claude; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog gate --agent claude --event PreToolUse; elif [ "${DUOLOG_DEPTH:-0}" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null; then exit 2; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog hook SessionEnd --agent claude; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog hook SessionStart --agent claude; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog hook wake --agent claude; fi
if command -v duolog >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec duolog hook UserPromptSubmit --agent claude; fi
